pr_metadata.body:
Owner phase observations now distinguish external material preparation/capture, queue and catalog waits, parent launch verification, sealed custodian preparation/GO wait/runtime verification/leader lifetime/drain, output validation and publication/recovery copy intervals. Each owner uses bounded monotonic clocks; saved open history becomes incomplete on reopen. Diagnostic evidence never supplies execution, result or readiness authority.

Two additive selected operations and matching CLI reads expose current-authority, exact catalog/Run or latest actor/graph/revision observations. Pre-Run preparation is explicitly latest volatile operation/material/clock evidence and never identifies an old preflight reply by graph revision alone. All120 prior whole contracts and frozen legacy discovery remain equal. Optional missing, malformed, foreign or empty helper diagnostics preserve valid parent evidence and unchanged completed results.

This draft targets PR102 and normally composes the whole reviewed coordinator UI. Independent root source/consumer review is clear. Actual disposable PostgreSQL/process source timing module14passed at5c9e6f9; preceding affected53passed atbdcc; root independent9passed at5c, and exact composed96c2ade timing+coordinator-pin15passed, all zero skips. Clock, queue/cancel, singleGO/custody, original publication fault/recovery, cold history, current lock authority, selected HTTP/CLI and corruption boundaries are covered. Historical failures and source attribution remain in docs/plans/lab-workflow-reliability/reports/m3-phase-timing-core/.

Hosted exact-head/postmerge qualification and full M3 phase UI/browser T4/T8 remain pending; UI work continues separately. This is neutral CPU process evidence, with no model training, CUDA or scientific claim. Original publication retains its existing catalog transaction, so concurrent timing reads can refuse until release.
